issues.description: Method `addGuestStudents` has an inconsistent public API across artifacts: the problem statement/UML requires `addGuestStudents(int): void`, and the solution implements `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)`, but the template declares `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)`. This extra boolean parameter changes the required signature and will cause compilation/test failures for students implementing the specified single-parameter method.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to match the required API by changing the signature to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` and remove the `boolean validateInput` parameter. If input validation is desired, implement it internally without altering the public method signature.
